name: QuickKeys
description: Keyboard shortcuts for tab navigation, window snapping/split view, a quick switcher, tab cleanup, zoom, and global dark mode.

action.default_title: QuickKeys — click to toggle dark mode (see Options for all shortcuts)

cycle-pinned-tabs.description: Switch to the next pinned tab

move-tab-left.description: Move the active tab one position left

move-tab-right.description: Move the active tab one position right

pin-tab.description: Pin or unpin the active tab

move-tab-new-window.description: Move the active tab into a new window

split-left.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the left half of the screen

split-right.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the right half of the screen

snap-top-left.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the top-left quadrant

snap-top-right.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the top-right quadrant

snap-bottom-left.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the bottom-left quadrant

snap-bottom-right.description: Split the active tab into a new window snapped to the bottom-right quadrant

merge-window.description: Move a split-out tab back into the window it came from

close-tabs-right.description: Close all tabs to the right of the active tab

close-other-tabs.description: Close every tab except the active tab (pinned tabs are kept)

focus-mode.description: Close every unpinned tab except the active tab

discard-tab.description: Discard the active tab from memory without closing it

mute-tab.description: Mute or unmute the active tab

mute-other-tabs.description: Mute every tab except the active tab

copy-url.description: Copy the active tab's URL to the clipboard

screenshot-tab.description: Save a screenshot of the visible tab

zoom-in.description: Zoom in on the active tab

zoom-out.description: Zoom out on the active tab

zoom-reset.description: Reset zoom on the active tab

restore-recent-tabs.description: Reopen the last few closed tabs

open-incognito.description: Open the active tab's URL in an incognito window
